description: Find Albert Heijn stores near a Dutch postal code. If no postal_code is given, automatically uses the address from the member profile. Returns store id (use this for ah_get_last_chance_items), name, type, and address.

postal_code.description: Dutch postal code, e.g. '1234AB'. Optional — falls back to member address.
